notes: The ONE connector config for intraday_poc.connectors:AlpacaBarsConnector, validated default-deny against its spec(), and the one BOTH acquisition modes run through. Register once, then acquire in either mode: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source alpaca --catalog-source alpaca-src --connector intraday_poc.connectors:AlpacaBarsConnector --config @configs/source-backfill.json --activate; then --mode backfill for the history and --mode live for the forward top-up. RULING (2026-08-28, hardcoding audit): ONE SOURCE NAME, two modes. ADR-0014 keys checkpoints per (source, stream, MODE), so the two pulls already hold independent cursors without a second registration — while observations live at observations/<source>/ and a run document reads exactly ONE source, so the second source name this child used to ship (alpaca-live) put every live-acquired bar in a tree the documents never read: no error, just an unused store. One name also keeps the store homogeneous — one feed, one adjustment, one price series per (symbol, ts), which is what the model is fit on. First live pull: that mode's cursor starts empty and therefore at start below, so run it once the backfill has caught up; the bitemporal dedup (latest acquired_at wins) makes the overlap harmless, it only re-fetches. feed=sip because the free tier serves FULL consolidated-tape history (back to 2016) — the IEX-only restriction is a real-time restriction, not a historical one; the connector clamps the fetch window 16 minutes into the past to clear the free tier's SIP gate, which is also why a live-mode pull trails the tape by ~16 minutes. adjustment=all (splits + dividends) keeps the return series stationary for the model, and the forward loop READS it from this file (live.py --source-config) so the series it serves on is adjusted the way the trained one was; the one vendor knob the loop cannot take from here is the feed, because real-time SIP is not sold on the free tier (README, 'What to know before trusting the numbers'). Store a second source with adjustment=raw if as-traded fills ever matter. Secrets are env-var NAMES (key_env/secret_env defaults apply) — the material never enters this file, a snapshot, or any hash.
